title: Customer Directory, Medical Profiles & Credit Configuration

intro.title: Customer Directory & Credit Setup
intro.subtitle: Patient records, WhatsApp contact, B2B GSTIN place of supply, and credit limits

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 6, Part 1: Customer Directory, Medical Profiles and Credit Configuration. Building detailed patient profiles enables personalized care, digital WhatsApp invoices, and controlled store credit.
Open Customers and click New Customer. Enter the patient's full name, mobile number for WhatsApp delivery, and email.
For institutional or business clients, enter their fifteen-character GSTIN. MediFlow automatically extracts the state code and determines intra or inter-state GST rules.
Set financial credit parameters. Establishing a credit limit allows the customer to purchase via Khata credit while safeguarding your cash flow.
Save the customer. The profile is active instantly across all POS counters, with credit balances monitored on every bill. In Part 2, we explore Family Health Groups!

outro.takeaway: Customer Directory: Maintain verified patient records, B2B GSTIN tax states, and Khata credit limits to build lasting customer trust.
